caption: Probabilistically correct object pose estimation. Given (a) an input image and heatmap detections of the object semantic keypoints, the method conformalizes the heatmaps into (b) circular or elliptical prediction sets that guarantee probabilistic coverage of the groundtruth keypoints (e.g., 90%). It then propagates the keypoint uncertainty to the object pose, forming (c) a Pose UnceRtainty SEt (PURSE) that contains the groundtruth pose with the same probability. RANdom SAmple averaGing (RANSAG) samples from PURSE to generate (d) an average pose, and semidefinite relaxation computes (e) worst-case error bounds (blue duck: worst rotation error; red duck: worst translation error).
Beta distribution of the conditional coverage with epsilon = 0.1 and different n. The conditional probability becomes more concentrated around 1 - epsilon as n increases.

Empirical coverage (%) per LineMOD-Occlusion object under the four setups (gt-ball, gt-ellipse, frcnn-ball, frcnn-ellipse). The conformalized prediction sets attain the user-specified target coverage across objects.
